title: VolatilityProtection
tagline: A pool that protects both their LPs and their traders from the volatility of markets.
description: Uniswap v4 hook and 1Inch LOP are powerful enough, but what if someone can really make them talk and complement each other to achieve protection like no one else? Well, that's why our protection from volatility is the biggest gift to the market. It watches events and performs actions like rising fees and protecting funds with customized hedge strategies on LOP. Traders are also automatically protected if they make a swap in volatility conditions with the actual benefit of swapping in high volatility.
how_its_made:
We basically used Uniswap v4 hooks to be able to change the fees before the swap in case of volatility in markets, and Reactive smart contracts to watch over events from any chain or the same chain in our case and judge volatility and inform Uniswap v4 hooks.

Also, !inch LOP extensions to perform intent-based actions on the market to be able to get the best strategy to protect their funds.
Besides them, Solidity and Foundry are the main languages.
